A '''member''' of the [[Adnerem]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who worked as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] at some point joined the [[M'Yalfor'ac Order]]. By the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] he had reached the postion of officer within the order, serving second only to [[Quaal Tavier Catharius]], the general and leader of the order. The Adnerem was one of only two non-[[Bitthævrian/Legends|Bitthævrians]] in the entire order along with a fellow advisor to Quaal, a [[Khil]].<ref name="AE" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This Adnerem was first mentioned in the [[West End Games]] sourcebook ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' published in [[1995]] as a supplement for their Star Wars [[Roleplaying game]].
